import React, { useState } from 'react'; const AlertHistory: React.FC = () => { const [severity, setSeverity] = useState(''); const [status, setStatus] = useState(''); const [expandedId, setExpandedId] = useState(null); const [alerts] = useState([ { id: 1, timestamp: new Date(Date.now() - 7200000).toISOString(), src_ip: '203.45.67.89', dst_ip: '192.168.1.1', protocol: 'SSH', port: 22, attack_type: 'SSH Brute Force', confidence: 0.95, severity: 'critical', explanation: 'Multiple failed SSH login attempts detected from source IP', status: 'acknowledged', notes: 'Blocked with firewall rule' }, { id: 2, timestamp: new Date(Date.now() - 3600000).toISOString(), src_ip: '45.142.182.99', dst_ip: '192.168.1.1', protocol: 'ICMP', port: 0, attack_type: 'Ping Scan', confidence: 0.72, severity: 'medium', explanation: 'Suspicious ICMP ping sweep detected on network', status: 'new', notes: '' } ]); const filteredAlerts = alerts.filter(a => (severity === '' || a.severity === severity) && (status === '' || a.status === status) ); const handleExportCSV = () => { console.log('Export CSV clicked'); }; const handleExportPDF = () => { console.log('Export PDF clicked'); }; return (

Historique des Alertes

{filteredAlerts.map(alert => (
setExpandedId(expandedId === alert.id ? null : alert.id)} >
{alert.severity.toUpperCase()}

{alert.attack_type}

{alert.src_ip} → {alert.dst_ip}
{expandedId === alert.id ? '▼' : '▶'}
{expandedId === alert.id && (

{new Date(alert.timestamp).toLocaleString()}

{alert.src_ip}

{alert.dst_ip}

{alert.protocol} / {alert.port}

{alert.attack_type}

{(alert.confidence * 100).toFixed(0)}%

{alert.explanation}

)}
))}
); }; export default AlertHistory;
